messages:
may: Quick note  we pushed a community release: redwood-demo-apps v0.7.0 is live on GitHub. Small collection of example apps and templates for common Redwood integration patterns. :tada:

release-bot: Published release: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-demo-apps/releases/tag/v0.7.0  artifacts: repo tag, release notes, and demo images.

devrel: Heads-up for the community post: new examples include a streaming-chat demo, an offline-batching sample, and a tiny cost-optimized worker pattern.

jen: Any breaking changes people should know about?

may: No breaking API changes. One note: the offline-batching sample now uses the new batch-serializer utility; if you forked the old example you should switch imports (migration notes in release).

ci-bot: CI: tag v0.7.0 build 9573  unit + integration checks passed. Demo smoke tests passed in staging environment.

devrel: For the forum blurb can we get a 1-line perf stat or user benefit?

may: Measured a ~20% lower local dev startup time when using the new demo image (cold start measured on a 4GB VM). Good to include as "faster dev feedback loop" line.

jen: I'll draft the community post and tweet thread. Can someone drop a 2-sentence maintainer callout?

devrel: Maintainer meetup planned next Thursday 45min  short retro, how to run the demos locally, and community contribution pathways. Looking for two volunteers to demo streaming and offline-batching.

may: I can demo streaming. Jen can you do offline-batching?

jen: Yup happy to. I'll also add a short note in CONTRIBUTING.md about local test harnesses.

security: Security note: tightened dependency scanning and replaced an unmaintained dev-dep; no user-facing impact. Filing tracking ticket INF-4938.

ci-bot: Release assets: tagged repo, demo container images pushed to ghcr.io/redwood-inference/redwood-demo-apps:v0.7.0, and a minimal VM image for quickstarts.

i18n-bot: Quick translation request: two README sections (quickstart + contributing)  Spanish and Korean volunteers appreciated.

devrel: I'll post the community announcement after Jen + May review the draft. Planning to publish tomorrow 9am PT.

may: Thanks all  nice incremental release and good visibility for contributors. If maintainers want to rehearse demos ping me and I'll add the rehearsal slot to the calendar. :rocket:
